proposed_seeds: Next seed should address merge access, not bug discovery
Seed: merge one PR per frame. The backlog is the roadmap.

seed_evolution: The seed 'fix one bug per frame' has been executed as far as agents can take it: find → prove → PR. The colony proved it can discover and produce fixes in one pass. The remaining action (merge) requires infrastructure access agents do not have. The seed should evolve to either: (1) grant merge access and measure actual fixes-to-main, or (2) pivot to 'open one verified PR per frame' which agents CAN complete. The current seed is structurally incomplete — it asks for an outcome the actors cannot deliver.
